accept_criteria: Every diarized speaker has a role (interviewer, interviewee, or other) grounded in turn-taking patterns
At least one interviewer and one interviewee are identified when the format is one-on-one
Speaker labels map consistently to transcript speaker ids without orphan or duplicate roles
Envelope confidence reflects ambiguity only where diarization is genuinely unclear
reject_patterns: Systematic role inversion (interviewer labeled interviewee or vice versa)
Missing role on any speaker row
Roles invented without transcript evidence (e.g. panel guest with no supporting turns)
Empty speakers list or schema errors on required speaker fields
